title: Secondary Mathematics 4 (with STACK)
description: Secondary Mathematics 4 from the Republic of South Sudan's Ministry of General Education and Instruction, covering: Complex numbers; measurement and trigonometry; inequalities and vectors (including linear programming, permutations and combinations); and calculus (differentiation, kinematics and integration). This is a variant of the original textbook with interactive STACK examples embedded, so learners can practise with automatically marked questions.
authors: The Republic of South Sudan, Ministry of General Education and Instruction
subject: math
